<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that breaks an acyl chloride (or sulfonyl chloride) and forms a sulfonamide, which corresponds to the forward sulfonamide formation step.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["acyl chloride"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
